claim: AnalyticsService reads the till through public.pos_item_sales (ADR 0298), so the cost of goods, net sales and revenue concentration that ADR 0298 and its README row describe are served from main. Open while PR #703 lands the function with no caller. PR #617 carries the reader and flips this row to resolved; a reader that lands without flipping it fails the build.

The recommendation digest passes withSales to the recommendation engine, so its owner and manager recipients get the entries read from the till and its other recipients do not (ADR 0298 decision 9). Open until the third PR of ADR 0298's split, the digest's, lands and flips this row to resolved.

The two locked readings OD-241 (OPEN-DECISIONS.md:328) sets side by side both hold on main: ADR 0145's ROLE_POLICY reads admin as the owner row (ROLE_POLICY_ALIASES), and ADR 0164's RolesGuard admits only a role the route lists, by exact match, so it refuses admin on a route that does not name it.
